title: Marching with the Pink Parade: Evaluating Visual Search Recommendations for Non-binary Clothing Items
models_tested: This paper does not evaluate Large Language Models. It evaluates the visual search and recommendation systems of three e-commerce platforms: Amazon StyleSnap, Beagle.Vision, and Lykdat.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on gender bias in e-commerce visual search recommendations.
